entry.title: Depots: Theft-Proof, Self-Custodial Bitcoin For Billions Of Users
entry.summary: The inquiry highlights issues concerning the readability and formatting of posts when viewed on different platforms, notably on desktop. It appears that there are complications in viewing the entire content of posts, prompting a question about whether a special markup is being used to compose these entries. Additionally, it’s suggested to utilize a WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) editor, which serves as a tool to ensure that the content appears as intended before finalizing the post. This approach helps in maintaining the legibility and overall presentation of the information shared on various devices.
